name: Confirm a change
description: The gate on an agent's writes and deletes: Covia runs it for each call made through a gated grant. A write that makes something new goes ahead. An overwrite or a delete raises an approval in the owner's Inbox and goes ahead only once the owner approves; until then the call is refused, and nothing changes.

caller.description: Who is calling it: an agent, as <owner>:g:<id>

approved.description: Whether the owner approved it in the Inbox
